findings.runtime_evidence: Owned by fresh acceptance run; not established by this source review
findings.finding: No business write or locking SQL in new checkout package; only ordinary CartService.read invokes database.
Token validation precedes full-cart reread and shipping fields; missing/duplicate/foreign token clears current confirmation and returns409.
32 SecureRandom bytes become 43 Base64url characters; latest session-bound immutable snapshot includes required identifiers, row versions, unit prices, UTC Instant timestamps and total.
Session monitor serializes prepare/validate; actor captured before monitor and exact SessionIdentity equality rechecked inside; safe request userId and CUSTOMER role checked.
TTL defaults PT10M, positive constructor validation, now >= expiresAt rejected; expired token cleared lazily at validation; existing SessionSupport clears confirmation on establish/clear/invalidate.
Full cart equality checks itemId/productId/quantity/itemVersion/unitPrice and total; stock sufficiency reread, product version not confirmation field. No reservation or inventory hold.
Field code-point checks use InputChecks 1..50/30/255, aggregate errors, request-only redisplay; exact two-decimal line/total bounds; client amount/userId parameters ignored.
No receiver or token logging; confirmation/form/validation toString redact; controller stub409 explicitly not order success and retains valid token.
Technical IllegalStateException is not blindly treated as expired identity: sessionFailure checks actual session validity before selecting SessionExpiredException.

Fresh verifier cases separately cover CSRF rejection without consuming confirmation, field400 reuse, replacement clearing newer token policy, cross-session/account, price/root-fixture and real-HTTP cart changes, amount overflow and short TTL. This is verifier-code review only.
